publicEnglish.title: Package for Thurman
publicEnglish.objective: Go to the Larson Clothiers in the Stormwind Mage Quarter, and give Thurman Schneider his Sewing Kit.
publicEnglish.detail:
My son Thurman is an apprentice at the Larson Clothiers, in the Mage's Quarter.  He was in a hurry today and forgot his shears and needles.  I know a great <Class> like you must have important tasks at hand, but without his tools Thurman can't do his apprentice work!

Please, <Name>.  Can you take my son's sewing kit to him?  Larson Clothiers is one of two clothing shops in the Mage's Quarter - it's the one deeper in, near the Mage's Tower.
publicEnglish.progress: Are you here to buy clothes?
publicEnglish.complete:
Oh, blast! I thought forgetting my kit would free me from work. Now I guess I'll have to help the Larsons with their sewing...

Oh, well. Fun will come later I guess.

publicEnglish.title: Wine Shop Advert
publicEnglish.objective: Go to the Gallina Winery, and bring Suzetta Gallina the Wine Ticket for a free bottle of wine.
publicEnglish.detail:
If you talk to anyone about wine, then you know we Gallinas sell the best wine in Stormwind.  And we're not far, still in the Trade District along the city's lovely canals.

Here, take this pamphlet.  Bring it to my sister Suzetta at our shop for a complimentary bottle of our famous pinot noir.  You won't regret it!
publicEnglish.progress: Greetings and welcome, master/madam. Have you yet tried one of our fine wines?
publicEnglish.complete: Ah, so you've seen Renato? Well here you are, sir/ma'am. A bottle of our special pinot noir. You'll not find its equal in all of Azeroth!

publicEnglish.title: Harlan Needs a Resupply
publicEnglish.objective: Go to the Canal Tailor Shop and bring Rema Schneider the Cloth Request from Harlan Bagley.
publicEnglish.detail:
We've been doing a lot of business lately.  It seems like everyone is buying armor and sturdy clothes.  Almost like they expect a cold, harsh season ahead...

But those are future worries.  My worry today is that I'm running out of knitted clothing to sell.  I need another load from our supplier.

If you can take this request to Rema Schneider at the Canal Tailor and Fit Shop, I'd be most grateful.
publicEnglish.progress: You bring word from Mr. Bagley?
publicEnglish.complete:
It says here that Harlan's business is booming. That's good news, but I wonder why people have need of all that armor. I've heard nothing of open war... is there something the nobles aren't telling us?

Well, thank you for bringing the request. Here's your payment, and I'll see to it that Harlan gets his supplies.

english.title: Training the Beast
english.objective: Speak to Isaac Chan in Goldshire.
english.detail:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young hunter.
english.complete:
A fledgling hunter, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, <name>, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.

publicEnglish.title: Stormpike's Delivery
publicEnglish.objective: Deliver the Package for Stormpike to Mountaineer Stormpike in Loch Modan.
publicEnglish.detail:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
publicEnglish.progress: You come all the way from Stormwind? I hear it's getting dicey down there in the human lands, with brigands and orcs running about. A perfect place for a <class> to prove his worth!
publicEnglish.complete:
Aha! So Grimand finally finished my axe! I can't wait to try it against some troggs and kobolds!

Many thanks, <name>. It was a long distance to travel for this delivery.  Here are some coins for your efforts.
